description: Generic StockAuthority Admin wire contract. Admission remains closed until actual Native publisher and store acceptance. OpenAPI operations preserve their reviewed exact responses and headers.

StockAuthorityPublisherPending.description: Acknowledgement of a pending Native publisher selector only. ready remains false. registered is null on a capability read without a remote lookup, false if prepare has no verified acknowledgement, true only for the acknowledged original prepare selector.

commands.description: All six original commands required. cancel additionally requires committedCancellation=true.

committedCancellation.description: Optional postcommit-undispatched cancellation semantics; must be paired with cancel.

opaqueLineAttributes.description: Optional immutable binding-selected opaque Native line properties. Required when a binding selects nonempty line_attribute_keys.

sourceSha.description: Trusted deployed Core source binding when present, otherwise unknown.

enabled.description: Only false can execute in this cohort. true returns503; no flag/header/body enables checkout.

origin.description: Exact deployment-approved HTTPS origin; default-empty allowlist rejects configuration.

bearer_token.description: Write-only credential, encrypted with existing backend AES-GCM vault. Never returned or fingerprinted publicly.

configurationHash.description: Opaque encrypted-envelope revision digest, not a deterministic secret fingerprint.

external_item_ref.description: Exact opaque UTF-8 text <=1024bytes, no controls/invalidUnicode; never parsed, normalized or mapped by SKU.

line_attribute_keys.description: Exact property names on the original accepted Native checkout line. All selected keys are required. Internal, credential, contact and customer keys are rejected. Requires provider opaqueLineAttributes=true. Values remain opaque bounded JSON; no whole-cart or contact fallback.

result.description: Only safe typed configuration result; binding result requires current Native products:manage.

openapi.description: Real configuration/kernel operation. Store checkout participation is unavailable/OFF in this cohort; no Native checkout completion or public proof claim. Requires current Native settings:manage; binding operations also products:manage. Only currently issuable admin:read/write token scopes are accepted.
